name: Seated Knee Extension

instructions.description: Sit upright near the front of a chair with both feet flat on the floor.
Brace lightly through the trunk and keep one thigh supported by the seat.
Straighten one knee until the lower leg is lifted comfortably in front of you.
Lower slowly and repeat before changing sides.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use a smooth full pain-free range.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Add light resistance at the ankle if prescribed and tolerated.

commentsNotes: Do not kick the leg up with momentum.
Pause briefly at the top for control.
